definitions.gloss: scheduled time; fixed time; appointed time
definitions.explanation: The predetermined or officially scheduled time for something to happen, especially for transport departures, meetings, or events.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{定刻|ていこく}⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{定刻|ていこく}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{三十分|さんじっぷん}⟦{遅|おく}れた→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: The plane was thirty minutes behind schedule.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{定刻|ていこく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}まります→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{遅|おく}れない→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧ようにして⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The meeting will start at the scheduled time, so please don't be late.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word commonly used in transportation (trains, flights, buses) and business settings. Japanese trains are famous for their punctuality, so {定刻|ていこく}⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧ (on schedule) is the expected norm.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定刻|ていこく}⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧ (on schedule, on time)
- {定刻|ていこく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to arrive on schedule)
- {定刻|ていこく}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧ (to be behind schedule)
- {定刻|ていこく}⟦{発|はつ}→〜発：04026_hatsu⟧ (departing on time)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧: on time — more casual
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦{時刻|じこく}→時刻：03270_jikoku⟧: scheduled time — more descriptive
